entries.label: The G-Zero wins
entries.summary: The absence of global leadership deepens into a very dangerous period.
entries.quote: We're entering a uniquely dangerous period of world history on par with the 1930s and the early Cold War.

entries.label: Rule of Don
entries.summary: Weaker checks on executive power make US policy depend on one man's decisions.
entries.quote: The erosion of independent checks on executive power and the rule of law will increase the extent to which the US policy landscape depends on the decisions of one powerful man.

entries.label: US-China breakdown
entries.summary: Trump's return brings an unmanaged decoupling between the US and China.
entries.quote: Trump's return to office will unleash an unmanaged decoupling in the world's most important geopolitical relationship.

entries.label: Trumponomics
entries.summary: Trump's policies raise inflation and cut growth in a strong US economy.
entries.quote: Donald Trump is about to inherit a robust US economy, but his policies will undermine its strength this year through higher inflation and reduced growth.

entries.label: Russia still rogue
entries.summary: Russia is the biggest subverter of the global order.
entries.quote: Russia will do more than any other country to subvert the global order in 2025.

entries.label: Iran on the ropes
entries.summary: A weakened Iran keeps the Middle East volatile.
entries.quote: The Middle East will remain a combustible environment in 2025, for one big reason: Iran hasn't been this weak in decades.

entries.label: Beggar thy world
entries.summary: US and Chinese economic policies export disruption and speed up fragmentation.
entries.quote: The US and China will export disruption to everyone else this year, short-circuiting the global economic recovery and accelerating geoeconomic fragmentation.

entries.label: AI unbound
entries.summary: Light regulation and weak cooperation let AI capabilities and risks grow unchecked.
entries.quote: As most governments opt for lighter-touch regulation and international cooperation falters, AI capabilities and risks will continue to grow unchecked.

entries.label: Ungoverned spaces
entries.summary: Leadership vacuums leave many places and domains thinly governed.
entries.quote: The deepening G-Zero will leave many people, places, and spaces thinly governed and forgotten.

entries.label: Mexican standoff
entries.summary: Mexico faces US pressure, constitutional change and fiscal stress together.
entries.quote: Mexico will face formidable challenges this year in its relations with the US at a time of ongoing constitutional overhauls and fiscal stresses at home.

entries.label: Trump fails
entries.summary: Eurasia Group expects Trump to gain more foreign policy wins than commonly expected.
entries.quote: There are four reasons why Trump will rack up more foreign policy wins than is appreciated.
